events.latest_title: Severe Earthquake Strikes Kumamoto, Japan, Causing Casualties and Damage

events.title: Savannah Guthrie Appeals for Help in Search for Missing Mother
events.summary: Savannah Guthrie has made a heartfelt plea for information regarding her mother's disappearance, which occurred six months ago. The family is desperate for answers and is urging anyone with relevant information to come forward.
events.latest_title: Savannah Guthrie Appeals for Help in Search for Missing Mother

events.title: Trump's Settlement Fund Threat Complicates Attorney General Confirmation Talks
events.summary: Trump has threatened to advance a proposed $1.8 billion settlement fund if Senate Republicans do not confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general. events.title: Democrats Target Ohio Seat Amid Renewed Abuse Allegations Against Rep. Max Miller
events.summary: Allegations against Ohio Representative Max Miller regarding abuse have gained renewed attention, coinciding with a legal dispute involving his former spouse, who is related to a prominent political figure. This situation has opened a potential opportunity for Democrats to contest the congressional seat in the upcoming elections.

events.title: US Implements New Tariffs on Over 80 Countries Amid Forced Labor Concerns
events.summary: The United States has imposed new tariffs on over 80 countries, citing concerns over forced labor. This action replaces a temporary global duty that was enacted after the US Supreme Court invalidated previous tariffs in February.
events.latest_title: US Implements New Tariffs on Over 80 Countries Amid Forced Labor Concerns

events.title: Independent Autopsy of Nolan Wells Reveals Undetermined Cause of Death
events.summary: An independent autopsy conducted on Nolan Wells has concluded that the cause and manner of his death are 'undetermined.' The doctor who performed the autopsy noted that foul play could not be ruled out, raising further questions about the circumstances surrounding the Mississippi teen's death.
events.latest_title: Independent Autopsy of Nolan Wells Reveals Undetermined Cause of Death

events.title: Federal Reserve Faces Pressure to Adjust Interest Rates Amid Inflation Concerns
events.summary: As the Federal Reserve prepares for its July meeting, Chairman Kevin M. Warsh is under pressure to address rising inflation. The rate-setting committee will decide whether to raise interest rates or maintain the current levels, with inflation and affordability being key issues influencing their decision.
events.latest_title: Federal Reserve Faces Pressure to Adjust Interest Rates Amid Inflation Concerns

events.title: Democrats Select South Carolina for First Presidential Primary in 2028
events.summary: The Democratic National Committee has recommended that South Carolina hold the first presidential primary for the 2028 election cycle. This decision marks a significant shift in the primary calendar, as South Carolina will replace Iowa as the opening contest. The move aims to prioritize representation among Black and Latino voters, with Nevada also scheduled for an early primary.
events.latest_title: Democrats Select South Carolina for First Presidential Primary in 2028

events.title: Spain's World Cup Champions Celebrate with Royal Welcome and Parade
events.summary: Spain's World Cup-winning football team received a grand welcome from the country's royals and fans in Madrid. The team celebrated their victory over Argentina with a bus parade through the city, where large crowds gathered to show their support.

events.title: Court Denies Biden's Request to Block Release of Ghostwriter Interview Recordings
events.summary: A US appeals court has rejected Joe Biden's attempt to block the release of recordings from interviews with his memoir ghostwriter. The divided three-judge panel ruled that there is a significant public interest in disclosing the material. The decision is currently suspended until August 3, allowing Biden time to consider a further appeal.

events.title: England Secures Third Place with 6-4 Victory Over France in World Cup Thriller
events.summary: In a record-breaking World Cup third-place playoff, England defeated France 6-4. Bukayo Saka scored a hat trick, helping England to a significant lead of 4-0 at halftime. Despite a spirited comeback from France in the second half, England held on to secure their best World Cup finish since 1966.
events.latest_title: England Secures Third Place with 6-4 Victory Over France in World Cup Thriller

events.title: Spain Claims Second FIFA World Cup Title with Victory Over Argentina
events.summary: Spain has won its second FIFA World Cup title, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the final match. Ferran Torres scored the decisive goal in extra time, securing the victory after a 16-year wait for the championship. Fans celebrated the win across Spain and in various locations worldwide, including Times Square in New York.
events.latest_title: Spain Claims Second FIFA World Cup Title with Victory Over Argentina

events.title: Search Underway for Missing North Carolina Woman in Grenada
events.summary: Elizabeth Waddell, a 44-year-old woman from Cary, North Carolina, has been reported missing after last being seen swimming at Grand Anse Beach in Grenada. Her family is actively seeking assistance in locating her following her disappearance during a vacation.
events.latest_title: Search Underway for Missing North Carolina Woman in Grenada

events.title: Lebanese Army Deploys in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh Following Israeli Withdrawal
events.summary: The Lebanese army has begun deploying troops in the southern town of Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh after Israeli forces withdrew from the area. This move aligns with a U.S.-brokered plan, according to a senior Lebanese security official.
events.latest_title: Lebanese Army Deploys in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh Following Israeli Withdrawal

events.title: UN Chief Calls for Global Support for Syria's Recovery
events.summary: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres visited Syria for the first time since 2009, emphasizing the need for international support as the country recovers from its civil war. During his visit, he met with interim President Ahmed al-Sharaa and described the current situation in Syria as a 'pivotal moment.'
events.latest_title: UN Chief Calls for Global Support for Syria's Recovery

events.title: UNESCO Lists Lebanese and West Bank Sites as World Heritage in Danger
events.summary: UNESCO has added a Lebanese castle and an archaeological site in the occupied West Bank to its World Heritage in Danger list. This decision comes despite objections from Israel regarding the inclusion of these sites, which are affected by ongoing Israeli activities.
events.latest_title: UNESCO Lists Lebanese and West Bank Sites as World Heritage in Danger

events.title: Cuban Dissident Artist Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara Arrives in the US After Prison Release
events.summary: Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara, a prominent Cuban artist and dissident, arrived in Miami after being released from a five-year prison sentence. His release was contingent upon his exile from Cuba, following his arrest during the 2021 anti-government protests. Otero Alcántara is known for co-founding the San Isidro Movement, which advocates for artistic freedom and human rights in Cuba.
events.latest_title: Cuban Dissident Artist Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara Arrives in the US After Prison Release

events.title: Passenger Ferry Capsizes Off Guyana, Search and Rescue Underway
events.summary: A passenger ferry carrying 116 people has capsized off the coast of Guyana, prompting an ongoing search and rescue operation. Authorities report that at least 67 individuals have been rescued so far, while efforts continue to locate the remaining passengers and crew. The incident occurred between Georgetown and Port Kaituma, with a distress call made shortly after 11 PM local time.
events.latest_title: Passenger Ferry Capsizes Off Guyana, Search and Rescue Underway

events.title: Khalil al-Hayya Elected as New Leader of Hamas Following Run-off
events.summary: Khalil al-Hayya has been appointed as the new leader of Hamas after a run-off election against Khaled Meshaal. Al-Hayya, who was previously part of the five-member leadership council, succeeds Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in 2024.
events.latest_title: Khalil al-Hayya Elected as New Leader of Hamas Following Run-off

events.title: International Medieval Combat Federation Championship Held at Spøttrup Castle
events.summary: Nearly 600 armoured fighters from 30 countries have convened at Spøttrup Castle in Denmark for the International Medieval Combat Federation (IMCF) World Championship. The event transforms the historic fortress into a venue for full-contact historical combat, showcasing the skills of participants in a unique setting.
events.latest_title: International Medieval Combat Federation Championship Held at Spøttrup Castle

events.title: Thunderstorms to Clear Wildfire Smoke Ahead of World Cup Final
events.summary: Thunderstorms are expected to clear wildfire smoke from the Northeast United States before the World Cup final between Spain and Argentina. While the storm front has largely moved the smoke out of the Northeast, some smoke remains over the central US Warnings for unhealthy air quality are still in effect across a wide area.
events.latest_title: Thunderstorms to Clear Wildfire Smoke Ahead of World Cup Final

events.title: Lettuce Recall Issued Due to Cyclospora Contamination Risk
events.summary: Taylor Farms has issued a recall of iceberg lettuce shipped to 27 states due to potential contamination with Cyclospora, a parasite that can cause severe gastrointestinal illness. The affected states include Texas, Florida, Pennsylvania, Illinois, and New Jersey. The FDA has confirmed that a sample of the recalled lettuce tested positive for Cyclospora.
events.latest_title: Lettuce Recall Issued Due to Cyclospora Contamination Risk

events.title: Laos Unable to Confirm Methanol Poisoning in Tourist Deaths Due to Lack of Autopsies
events.summary: Laos officials have stated that they cannot determine the cause of deaths of tourists linked to methanol poisoning due to the absence of autopsies. As a result, there is no evidence to support claims of poisoning. Those indicted in connection with the deaths are facing charges related to selling harmful food and operating an illegal business.
events.latest_title: Laos Unable to Confirm Methanol Poisoning in Tourist Deaths Due to Lack of Autopsies

events.title: Rescue Efforts Underway in China After Landslide Traps Residents
events.summary: A large-scale rescue operation is underway in Pengshui County, Chongqing municipality, following a landslide on July 17 that buried part of a residential area. Authorities are working to locate and rescue an unknown number of people trapped under the debris.
events.latest_title: Rescue Efforts Underway in China After Landslide Traps Residents
